task.title: Search the union of sources across the toplevel project's option space
task.problem: Project options select sources, dependencies, variable-expanded source configuration and junction options through (?) conditionals and exported variables, so a search under one option set misses sources that other supported configurations reach.
task.proposal: Add --all-options: read the toplevel project.conf option declarations, enumerate bool/enum/arch/os/flags values (holding element-mask and -o pinned options), load each option set as the toplevel project in one BuildStream session, merge trees by digest and attribute each element record with the option sets that reached it.
acceptance: The union of option sets finds sources selected by conditional sources, conditional dependencies, option-exported source variables and options forwarded through junctions.
Combinations rejected by a project (!) assertion are skipped with a note; other load failures and uncached trees name their option set and exit 2.
A configurable cap refuses combinatorial explosions before loading; -o pins an option.
Each unique tree is searched once; JSON records list every option set that reached them and text output keeps its format.
Runs without --all-options keep their output, statuses and records.
evidence: tests/test_option_space.py and test_all_options_searches_union_of_option_sets pass against BuildStream 2.8.1 with FUSE; full suite 131 passed locally.
